title: Absolutely gorgeous presentation
text: Absolutely gorgeous presentation. Nordic Ware's Violet Bundt Pan makes an absolutely stunning presentation; criss-crossed with tendrils and ringed with a base of raised-detail violet leaves, the top of the cake is sprinkled with a ring of raised violets. The details show off particularly well when using unglazed cakes (a dusting of powdered sugar on darker cakes or a dusting of cocoa on lighter cakes will bring out the details). This is always a showstopper when I make my signature Mexican Fudge Pecan Cake from [[ASIN:1580085628 The Pastry Queen: Royally Good Recipes from the Texas Hill Country's Rather Sweet Bakery & Cafe]], and people always think that my cakes made in the Violet Bundt came from some upscale bakery. Pricey, but it's made in the USA and will be a faithful friend for years.
